text:
Mia (eng-infra): Heads-up — product is shipping a pricing tier change next month that bumps the free rate-limit and doubles the per-minute quota for Pro. Need quick capacity estimate: what does +20-30% request volume to the hosted API translate to in GPU hours?
Sam (finance): got the note. Our sims show ~23% more peak qps for text-gen and ~15% for embeddings if adoption skews Pro. revenue side ok but infra cost needs number.
Jordan (product): confirmed. We're phasing the rollout over 2 weeks with a 10% weekly ramp then open. Also allowing short burst windows for trial signups. Expect concentrated signups in EU and US regions first.
Alex (eng-ml): rough calc from last month's telemetry: baseline hosted text-gen steady-state 3k qps -> ~190 A100-hours/day with current batching. A 25% qps rise -> ~240 A100-hours/day assuming no batching change.
Lee (sre-oncall): caveat: us-west1 cluster already at 78% committed capacity during afternoons. If traffic shifts there we'll hit cold-start delays. Need pre-warm plan or soft quotas.
Mia (eng-infra): can we translate that to GPUs to reserve? asking for a concrete ask to finance/proc.
Alex (eng-ml): using our efficiency factor (tokens/sec per GPU) and avg session length, I'd request +40 A100s in pooled capacity to cover peak for 3 weeks of rollout with 20% safety. If we push quantized variants to Pro by default it could drop to +28 A100s.
Sam (finance): procurement lead: we can commit to a 3-month burst reserve contract but need exact start/end and region. Budget prefers north-virginia first then eu-west.
Jordan (product): can we gate EU burst to week 2? initial launch US-only week 1. That gives infra time to observe patterns.
Lee (sre-oncall): operational ask: create a canary routing rule to limit new Pro sessions to 10% of capacity until we validate latency. Also add an autoscaler runbook tweak: lower scale-down threshold from 5m to 90s for that pool to reduce cold-start tail.
Mia (eng-infra): noted. Also network note: increased Pro embeddings -> significantly more small requests; that stresses connection churn. We should bump per-node ephemeral port limits and check NAT gateway quotas in eu-west.
Alex (eng-ml): embed request rate per-second model: +15% embed qps -> ~12% higher p50 token rate but p99 tail grows ~30% w/o improved batching. Recommend enabling prefix caching for common prompts and aggressively coalescing small requests at the edge.
Sam (finance): cost rough: +40 A100s at current on-demand-ish pricing -> ~$220k/month. If we take dedicated reserved discount (3mo) we drop to ~$150k/month. Buckets make a big difference.
Mia (eng-infra): action items: 1) Alex to finalize GPU-hours -> exact A100-count by EOD. 2) Lee to draft autoscaler/runbook changes and NAT port matrix. 3) Sam to draft 3mo vs on-demand cost with region split. 4) Jordan to confirm staged rollout dates.
Jordan (product): staging dates locked: US week of Jun 1, EU week of Jun 8, global open Jun 15.
ops-bot: autoscaler: scheduled job created -> "prewarm-pro-tier-pool" starting 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-06-21T23:59:00Z, target extra GPUs: 40, regions: us-west1, us-central1, eu-west1.
Lee (sre-oncall): I added a quick check script to rotation: `/scripts/check-nat-ports.sh` and a dashboard tile for ephemeral port usage. Also flagged NAT quota request to cloud for eu-west1 (inc case: 2x current).
Alex (eng-ml): dropping a config snippet for canary routing we agreed on:
```
route_rules:
  - name: pro-tier-canary
    percent: 10
    pool: prewarm-pro-tier
    fallback_pool: default-hosted
```
Mia (eng-infra): Great. Final ask before I escalate to procurement: if quantized Pro variant is enabled by default, what's the realistic reduction in GPU-hours? Alex?
Alex (eng-ml): conservatively 25-30% less GPU-hours for text-gen workloads when using q4/k8 variants with current model family. But need regression tests on quality.
Sam (finance): if quality tests pass we prefer quantized default — lower infra opex and smaller reserve purchase. Please attach eval pass/fail threshold to the procurement ticket.
Mia (eng-infra): thanks everyone. I'll open the reserve request and link this thread. Ping me if numbers change. :thumbsup:
